sources.role: Android container front-end and UI integration reference
sources.notes: Use selected app-private container lifecycle/display/input code as a reference; do not copy the whole UI into Ae without review.

sources.role: Android Wine + Box86/Box64 + PRoot + graphics integration reference
sources.notes: Best starting architecture for an Android Windows-userland container; upstream README reports device-dependent compatibility and Vulkan/GPU requirements.
Build/port only required architectures and components; requires runtime DLLs and application-specific compatibility work.

sources.role: x86-64 user-mode instruction translation to ARM64
sources.notes: Use with a suitable Linux rootfs/Wine integration. Native Termux mode is documented as experimental and does not run ordinary Linux binaries.
Legacy 32-bit path; validate ABI and rootfs dependencies separately.
Does not replace the Android kernel or remove app sandbox restrictions. GPL distribution obligations must be reviewed.
Only where Android Vulkan driver and required extensions are supported.
Proton-focused project; Android integration and driver features require proof.
Requires an Ae OpenFX host/adapter. Not binary-compatible with Adobe .aex.
Android is listed as supported but less well tested than Windows/macOS/Linux.
Evaluate as a compact alternative to Wasmtime; do not bundle both by default.

sources.role: ARM64 Linux/Wine x86 Windows application emulation architecture
sources.notes: Useful alternative architecture; upstream target is AArch64 Linux, not a ready Android app runtime.

sources.role: x86/x86-64 user-mode emulator for ARM64 Linux
sources.notes: Official FAQ says the full FEX environment does not target Android due syscall, filesystem and GPU access differences. FEXCore library reuse is a separate experiment.
